title: DeFi Protocol Revenue Multiples and Token Returns: Dataset and Replication Code
description: Dataset and fully reproducible code accompanying the working paper 'Does Revenue Back Valuation? Protocol Revenue Multiples and the Cross-Section of Token Returns in Decentralized Finance.' Includes data-collection scripts built on the free DefiLlama and CoinGecko APIs (no paid keys), the constructed cross-sectional and monthly-panel datasets, and an analysis script that regenerates every figure and statistic in the paper. The study tests whether protocol revenue multiples explain token valuations and predict the cross-section of forward returns; the return sample is formed circa June 2025 with a twelve-month forward window.
